  • Constructor Details

    • VolumeSlider

      public VolumeSlider(float x, float y, float width, float height, String label, Consumer<Float> onVolumeChanged)
      Initializes a generic volume slider with a custom label and a callback for value changes. The callback allows the slider to be reused for different audio channels like music or sound effects.
